key_idea: The unlocked set is the Minkowski sum of a diamond of radius a (#4s) and a square of radius b (#8s), so order does not matter: (x,y) is unlocked iff max(|x|,|y|) <= a+b and |x|+|y| <= a+2b.
sketch: Prefix-count the 8s to get a and b for each substring in O(1). Then test the two octagon inequalities with 64-bit arithmetic. O(n+q). Only pitfall is deriving the second inequality (each 8 can contribute 2 to the Manhattan distance, each 4 only 1).
